lines.text: Many learners say: We were five in the car.
Better: There were five of us in the car.
Say there were five of us.
Of us! There were three of us at the table.

data.wrong: We were five in the car.
data.right: There were five of us in the car.
data.why: Say there were five of us.

quiz.stem: There were three ___ at the table.
